evals.prompt: Run a standard LAA review of evals/fixtures/clean-how-to.md. Treat it as a standalone article with no PR diff. Return the normal report and do not edit the file.
evals.expected_output: The article has no blocker or major findings. Applicable categories are marked Pass, code-related categories are omitted or N/A, and no unsupported ai-usage claim is made.
assertions: The report contains an applicability-aware review coverage section.
The report does not claim that code samples were executed.
The report does not fabricate repository-specific requirements.

evals.prompt: Run a standard LAA review of evals/fixtures/incomplete-procedure.md. Return the normal report and do not fix the file.
evals.expected_output: The report identifies missing procedure context, an unlabeled code fence, placeholder code, and lack of runability evidence without claiming execution.
assertions: The report flags the placeholder comment as a Major code-sample completeness problem.
The report flags the missing code-fence language identifier.
The report classifies runability as unverified rather than runnable.
The report identifies at least one task-completeness omission.

evals.prompt: Run a standard LAA review of evals/fixtures/legacy-overview.md. This is unchanged legacy content, and no authorship or diff evidence is available. Return the normal report without editing.
evals.expected_output: The review marks AI disclosure N/A or omits it and does not report the missing ai-usage field as a failure.
assertions: Missing ai-usage is not reported as Blocker, Major, or Minor.
The report explains that disclosure applicability cannot be inferred without change context.

evals.prompt: Run a standard LAA review of evals/fixtures/overlay-repo/article.md. Treat evals/fixtures/overlay-repo as the owning repository and apply its .github/copilot-instructions.md overlay. Return the normal report without editing.
evals.expected_output: The review flags only the applicable repository-defined ending, alert-count, and Azure CLI language rules, cites the overlay path, and does not call those conventions Learn-wide.
assertions: Each overlay-derived finding cites .github/copilot-instructions.md as its rule source.
The report flags the missing required ending section.
The report flags more than two alerts.
The report recommends azurecli for the Azure CLI fence.
The report does not describe overlay rules as Learn-wide.
